{{Top|leg}}
The '''Assemblage''' was the name given to the nearly-public forum established during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as the basis for its government. Based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Assemblage was made up of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|representatives]], and the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] was drawn from its ranks.
